evidence: Judge agent and model: task/task.toml:30-35 is the frozen shared [verifier.env] block byte-for-byte as staged-task-contract.md:66-71 (REWARDKIT_JUDGE = "claude-code", REWARDKIT_MODEL = "z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx", OpenRouter base URL, templated token, empty ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). All five judge.toml files carry only the expected `judge = "claude-code"` fallback at line 2; a grep for model/temperature/reasoning/effort keys in tests/*/*/judge.toml returns nothing. test.sh:63-66 writes zero and exits when either variable is absent, so the judge cannot silently fall back to another model. Judge CLIs and browser: task/tests/Dockerfile:16-22 pins @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1; :31 pins harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7; :33-38 installs Chromium through the Playwright bundled inside the pinned @playwright/mcp package, so the browser build follows that pin, and every judge.toml points at it with --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium. Shared builds: tests/Dockerfile, tests/test.sh, tests/tools/score.py, tests/tools/restart_mcp.py, tests/scoring.toml and environment/Dockerfile have the same SHA256 as the frozen template copies (prefixes 72998ab8, bd682592, 13de2b38, 03c1426f, 95f70d6e, 0a75419e). score.py and restart_mcp.py contain no pip/npm/curl/remote fetch; the prompts and app_context.md reference no non-localhost URL. Fixed clock: this task grades no calendar or run-date rule. A grep over the brief, the six notes, app_context.md, the prompts, all criteria and seed_data.json finds no clock, date, today, timestamp, age or ordering-by-time requirement; the only time language is relative durations inside one run (five-second run budget, about-one-second and four-second timers, ten-second cross-tab windows in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:281, 299, 308, 317, 380, 398). The golden's new Date().toISOString() at solution/app/server.js:71, 84, 111 only stamps stored rows and no criterion reads it. So the result does not depend on the day the verifier runs and there is nothing to anchor to a fixed clock. Not defects under this row: bases node:22-bookworm-slim and python:3.12-slim (tests/Dockerfile:1-2) are tag-pinned rather than digest-pinned and apt packages (:12-14) are unversioned; both are unchanged template lines and the workbook's check-dockerfiles.py treats unpinned apt as a NOTE. Open verifier network (task.toml:37-38) is correct per the row text. Temperature and prompt-version markers are not required per the public sheet, which supersedes the internal sheet's older wording. Runtime: no configured judge run exists for these bytes (raw-evidence-index scope); the hosted run in the index is an earlier candidate. That gap does not bear on this row, which is a source property verified directly on the frozen bytes.
